label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交为分块解析引入“重解析延迟”（reparse deferral）：解析器新增状态字段（上次尝试的长度、是否延迟等），在遇到未完成的大 token 时推迟重新解析。这是新增内部状态与复用契约的改动，表面上与隐式 state 阳性相同。但 xml_parse_fuzzer 对同一个解析器按块多次调用 XML_Parse，并对奇数长度输入调用 XML_ParserReset 复用解析器，新状态的设置、判断与重置在定额 fuzz 下于多个种子中被执行。harness 无需修改，属于隐式 state 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit introduces reparse deferral for chunked parsing: the parser gains new state fields (last attempted length, whether to defer) and postpones re-parsing when a large token is still incomplete. This adds internal state and changes the reuse contract, which on the surface matches a silent state positive. But xml_parse_fuzzer calls XML_Parse repeatedly on the same parser and reuses it via XML_ParserReset for odd-sized inputs, so setting, testing and resetting the new state runs in several seeds under the fuzz budget. No harness update needed: silent state negative.
